title: Audio Tags For Inworld TTS-2
tagline: Enables natural language steering capabilities for Inworld TTS-2.
description:
This plugin enables your dialogue LLM of choice to dynamically control NPC voices for characters using Inworld TTS-2. It directs voice performance using plain-English instructions for a better-sounding and more immersive TTS experience.

This requires you to:
- Set `inworld-tts-2` as the active Inworld model.
- Enable `Audio tags` in the configuration.
author: jykej
changelog:
Added new non-verbal reactions, every addition personally tested across multiple voices. Many of the new non-verbal tags listed as supported by Inworld don't work.
Refined the audio-tagging instructions for more expressive vocal steering. Focused on concrete, effective delivery that consistently produce good results, with less emphasis on properties that tend to cause excessive voice drift.
Experimented with various approaches, but keeping the overall structure largely intact produced the best results and remained broadly aligned with Inworld's documentation. YMMV.
